title: Cosmic Dragon Dreamer
description: A green-skinned female figure with long purple braided hair reclines on an ornate bed floating in space, holding a glowing orb. A large iridescent blue and purple dragon with red eyes curves beside her, surrounded by melting celestial portals, gothic castles, hot air balloons, and dripping white and red poppies against a black cosmic backdrop.
prompt: A green-skinned woman with long purple braided hair lounges on an ornate wooden bed with white pillows, holding a glowing orb that drips white liquid. A large iridescent blue-purple dragon with red eyes coils beside her. They float within a gothic archway opening into a swirling galaxy filled with stars and nebulae. Floating gothic castles, hot air balloons, crescent moons, and melting white and red poppies with dripping paint fill the scene against a black cosmic background.
